source_columns: usewithparent_weekday, usewithparent_weekend, aloneuse_weekday, aloneuse_weekend, usewithothers_weekday, usewithothers_weekend, child_access, child_access_wave2, child_freq_parent_wave2, child_freq_alone_wave2, childfreq_others_wave2
expression:
local({
  nonuser <- child_access %in% 0 | child_access_wave2 %in% 0
  parent <- 5 *
    if_else(is.na(usewithparent_weekday) & (nonuser | child_freq_parent_wave2 %in% 1), 0, usewithparent_weekday) +
    2 * if_else(is.na(usewithparent_weekend) & (nonuser | child_freq_parent_wave2 %in% 1), 0, usewithparent_weekend)
  alone <- 5 *
    if_else(is.na(aloneuse_weekday) & (nonuser | child_freq_alone_wave2 %in% 1), 0, aloneuse_weekday) +
    2 * if_else(is.na(aloneuse_weekend) & (nonuser | child_freq_alone_wave2 %in% 1), 0, aloneuse_weekend)
  others <- 5 *
    if_else(is.na(usewithothers_weekday) & (nonuser | childfreq_others_wave2 %in% 1), 0, usewithothers_weekday) +
    2 * if_else(is.na(usewithothers_weekend) & (nonuser | childfreq_others_wave2 %in% 1), 0, usewithothers_weekend)
  all <- parent + alone + others
  share <- parent / all
  case_when(
    is.na(all) | all == 0 ~ NA_character_,
    share == 0 ~ "Never",
    share <= 0.1 ~ "Rarely",
    share <= 0.35 ~ "Sometimes",
    share <= 0.7 ~ "Often",
    .default = "Always"
  )
})
notes: Parent report, smartphone and tablet use only, both waves, typical weekday and weekend day: share of use with a parent, 'Use with parents' over that plus 'Solo use' and 'Use with siblings or others' (Table 2), weighted 5:2, cut at the day shares (0 Never, up to 10% Rarely, up to 35% Sometimes, up to 70% Often, above 70% Always). Partial: hours beside hours, one medium. Parts routed past are 0 (child_access = 0, child_access_wave2 = 0, or that part's frequency item = 1, never); no mobile use at all is NA. child_freq_parent_wave2 (codes 2-7 undocumented), child_unsupervised and child_supervision_wave2 (no wording or code list) are named unused.
